evidence.quote: As a fully integrated provider, we deliver affordable, high-quality pharmaceutical intermediates, superior APIs, and finished dosage forms (FDFs) to over 100 countries worldwide. || Headquartered in Tribiano, just 10 km outside Milan, the company operates 11 production facilities across Italy, along with administrative offices located near its headquarters.
